summary: Atlanticus Holdings disclosed on Form 8-K (Item 8.01) that subsidiary Mercury Financial, LLC completed the sale and assignment of the MERCURY word mark and related intellectual property to an unaffiliated third party on September 30, 2026, for $27.5 million in cash. Underlying consumer credit card receivables from the MERCURY-branded program remain with the Company. The purchaser granted a non-exclusive, royalty-free 12-month license to solicit new card consumers via the mark, plus up to five additional years for servicing legacy accounts and regulatory obligations. Watch brand-transition execution, bank-partner consent, and any further monetization or goodwill implications.
